formatting_diagnostic_config.applied_to: raw prompt_text (not S2-normalized - normalization collapses newlines, which line-anchored list/step markers depend on)
formatting_diagnostic_config.multi_sentence_rule: count of [.!?]+ matches >= 2, on raw prompt_text

flagged_implementation_ambiguities.note: S2 lists whitespace-collapse before the URL-placeholder bullet but does not state execution order between the two. Implemented order: NFKC -> lowercase -> URL substitution -> whitespace collapse/strip. Effect on this pool is expected to be nil (URLs, if any, contain no internal whitespace requiring reordering) but is flagged rather than silently assumed.

S9 specifies 'logistic regression predicting source from tail membership alone; report accuracy/AUC against majority-class baseline' but does not specify a train/test split. Implemented as an in-sample fit-and-evaluate on the full scored pool (this is a diagnostic characterizing association in the realized sample, not a held-out predictive-generalization claim).

flagged_implementation_ambiguities.location: S9 item 8, length sensitivity 'tail membership changes'
flagged_implementation_ambiguities.note: S9 does not specify how tail membership is redefined from the length-residualized percentile. Implemented: residuals are converted to an empirical percentile within the scored pool using the same '<' + 0.5*'=' / N rule as S6, then the same 0.75/0.25 cutoffs are applied; rows whose tail label differs from the original are counted as 'changed'.

S9 names the required categories (list markers, numbered steps, code-block delimiters, multi-sentence structure) but not exact regexes. Implemented regexes are recorded verbatim in the pilot JSON output's formatting_diagnostic_config field for auditability.

method_configuration.grouping: exact/normalized-dup seed + character-5gram shingle Jaccard >= 0.6 union-find
method_configuration.method1: LOGO TF-IDF centroid distance, word n-grams (1,2), smoothed sklearn-style IDF, group-local vocab (policy B), stopwords retained
method_configuration.method2: LOGO smoothed token self-information, unigrams only, alpha=1.0, stopwords retained
